result.title: Model the Annotation, Not the Noise: Semantic Annotation-Channel Prompt Learning against Noisy Labels
result.summary: Parameter-efficient prompt learning has become a cornerstone for adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), yet it remains highly vulnerable to label noise in few-shot Web and retrieval scenarios. Existing noise robust methods typically rely on hard sample selection or deterministic label correction, which discard valuable semantic ambiguity and overlook how observed annotations are actually generated. To bridge this gap, we reformulate noisy prompt learning through the perspective of data generation, proposing SACP, a Semantic-aware Annotation Channel-based Prompt learning framework. Instead of suppressing noise heuristically, SACP decouples latent clean-label prediction from instance-dependent annotation generation. By integrating frozen VLM semantic priors with lightweight visual residuals, SACP constructs a structured annotation channel optimized via generalized expectation-maximization with soft posteriors. Furthermore, a posterior-aware memory is introduced to preserve label uncertainty during test-time inference. Extensive experiments across different synthetic benchmarks and the real-world noisy Food101N dataset demonstrate that SACP achieves state-of-the-art performance against its counterparts in different label noise patterns, especially under severe asymmetric noise.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 SACP，将含噪标签的 prompt learning 视为生成过程，把潜在干净标签预测与实例相关的标注生成解耦，用冻结 VLM 语义先验加轻量视觉残差构造标注通道，并以广义 EM 的软后验优化，另设后验感知记忆在测试时保留标签不确定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以软后验建模潜在干净状态、并按实例保留不确定性的做法，或可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 假设的加权与视觉证据可信度估计；但任务限于分类标签噪声，与推理状态生成无直接联系。
